### “RE”: The Most Beautiful Prefix in History
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-18-2016.html
Passage: Isaiah 44:22
Points:
- God consistently invites His people to return instead of abandoning them when they fail.
- The biblical prefix "re" reveals the Lord's heart to renew, restore, and revive contrite souls.
- Recurring stumbles and past mistakes never exhaust God's willingness to extend fresh redemption.
- Believers are urged to turn back to Jesus, who lovingly rebuilds broken lives.

### I Have Redeemed You
Author: Truth for Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-february-10-2018.html
Passage: Isaiah 44:22
Points:
- Transgressions resemble dark clouds that obscure the comfort of God's presence and threaten judgment.
- God shows profound mercy by completely erasing sin from existence rather than leaving it over us.
- The redemptive sacrifice on the cross permanently cancels the believer's guilt.
- Pardoned sinners are called to cast aside lingering fear and return to intimate fellowship with the Lord.
